summary: Comprehensive testing of AI-generated contribution descriptions feature for 4Luis crowdfunding platform. All features working correctly: Backend POST /api/admin/generate-contribution-descriptions returns 7 contextualized AI descriptions using GPT-5.2, Admin panel has 'Gerar com IA' button with Sparkles icon, button shows loading state and fills all 7 description fields, button correctly disabled when journey name is empty.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/admin/generate-contribution-descriptions returns 200 with 7 descriptions (keys: 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000)
Backend: Endpoint generates contextual descriptions for different destinations (tested Japão, Itália)
Backend: Endpoint requires journey_name - returns 400 when missing or empty
Backend: Endpoint requires admin authentication - returns 401 without auth
Backend: Endpoint requires admin role - returns 403 for non-admin users
Backend: AI uses GPT-5.2 via emergentintegrations.llm.chat for generation
Backend: Generated descriptions are saved correctly via PUT /api/admin/journeys/{journey_id}
Backend: Saved descriptions persist and are returned in GET requests
Frontend: Admin edit form shows 'Gerar com IA' button with Sparkles icon next to 'Descrições de Contribuição' header
Frontend: Button has correct data-testid='generate-ai-descriptions-btn'
Frontend: Button shows gradient styling (from-[#FFBE98] to-[#F2C94C])
Frontend: Clicking button triggers API call and fills all 7 description input fields
Frontend: Button shows 'A gerar...' text during loading (generatingDescs state)
Frontend: Button is disabled when journey name field is empty
Frontend: Button is enabled when journey name is filled
Frontend: Admin can save AI-generated descriptions by clicking 'Guardar Alterações'
Frontend: After saving, reopening edit form shows the saved descriptions
Frontend: CheckoutModal on homepage shows China journey descriptions correctly
Frontend: All 7 amounts (€10-€1000) display with their respective descriptions in CheckoutModal
Frontend: Selected amount shows highlighted styling with checkmark icon
critical_code_review_comments: AI generation endpoint correctly uses emergentintegrations.llm.chat with GPT-5.2 model
Button disabled state correctly tied to editingJourney.name
generatingDescs state properly controls button text between 'Gerar com IA' and 'A gerar...'
All 7 contribution amounts have data-testid attributes for testing (contrib-desc-10 through contrib-desc-1000)
Error handling displays alert on generation failure
seed_data_creation: Japan journey (journey_japan001) now has AI-generated contribution descriptions saved
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI contribution descriptions generation feature fully tested. The 'Gerar com IA' button appears in the Admin edit form for journeys under 'Descrições de Contribuição' section. Japan journey now has AI-generated descriptions. China journey has pre-existing manual descriptions. Button uses data-testid='generate-ai-descriptions-btn'. Description inputs use data-testid='contrib-desc-{amount}' pattern.
